referenceDocument.title: BUYPASS Platform Issuer Identification Number (IIN) Reference Manual

trainingInterpretation.rule: ATL105 retains message-format and field representation rules; the IIN Reference Manual supplies the separately versioned Card Type ID, IIN Length, PAN Length and PAN range catalog for credit, debit and EBT cards where referenced.
constraints: Apply the IIN catalog only to credit, debit and EBT cards; fleet cards are referred to the Petroleum specification instead by the same element.
Do not replace ATL105 field lengths, encoding, segment placement, transaction format or other message rules.
The word 'most recent' does not itself establish that the local 2024-1 IIN manual is the currently governing release.
All entries remain draft and review-required; no source conflict, SME approval, execution readiness or model-weight training is implied.
